what: Several large sentences stacked in the same place are split into lines. When the panel center reaches the screen center it pins and ties to scroll (scrub .6): the previous sentence’s lines rotate away on the Y axis to −105° and the next sentence’s lines come around from 105° → 0° — each line .12 later, with the origin 620px behind so the lines look attached to the circumference of a cylinder as it turns (perspective 1600, phone 800). It rests .6 beat between sentences.

options.depth: Cylinder Radius = Distance behind origin (px), default 620
options.length: Fixed length multiplier (screen height × number of beats × this value), default .58 · phone phone-length .34
options.pin: off means no pinning · parent pins the whole parent panel holding the sentence (original form)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Sentences to overlay — two or more

note: Splitting lines with SplitText is more accurate when attached after all fonts have loaded (fx-core attaches after DOMContentLoaded). With the reduced setting, only the first sentence shows

from.where: index.html About sentence — original Statement (two .text, rotationY 105, transformOrigin 50% 50% -620px)
